payload.title: Decide which links count as evidence, and handle hub concepts
payload.description: Proposed weights, for review: a person's tag or accepted link highest; `mentions` next; unreviewed `related_to` suggestions never count toward a rank. Hubs: two concepts hold most links, one seemingly the publisher's own product. Exclude kinds personAuthor and identifier from concept ranks, and down-weight hubs through PMI rather than a stop list (no arbitrary lists). One function, used by every rank.
